negative_reviews.author: Gabriele
negative_reviews.text: Fried KFC-style chicken and something they call “ramen”. I’m pretty sure a Japanese grandmother is crying somewhere.

negative_reviews.author: D George
negative_reviews.text: It’s a Nice looking restaurant and comfortable and  the staff are friendly . There’s a good selection of dishes on the menu. The food was tasty but I was expecting slightly better quality

negative_reviews.author: Ri
negative_reviews.text: Went early evening (around 5) when the restaurant was practically empty hoping for good food. I did not rate the food at all. Ended up sending a dish back and getting it redone which showed that the chicken in the original meal sent was burnt (see photos, forgot to take a picture of the chicken when it was redone). Very shy on the amount of chicken too. Bubble tea lemonade was very sweet (but that’s just my taste). Kayleigh was a great host/server. Lovely energy and very helpful. Not sure of the other ladies names but they were all welcoming. Amazing staff, poor food!

issues: Covers rose by 121 (11.96%) to 1,132 week on week and spend per head rose by £0.40 (1.69%) to £24.03, which the report calls a good week for SPH.
Sales were £29,002.88, up £4,092.08 (16.42%) week on week but £3,997.13 (12.11%) below the £33,000 target.
Promotions run across Lakeside lifted sales by around £5,000, and the push is continuing this week.
Monday sales improved from £1,600 to £3,000, helped by Lakeside's own marketing and Hits Radio advertising, and a ramen test tube guessing game drove customer engagement.
Labour was increased to deliver the promotion and stood at 22.41% including Kei Cannon's hours; the GM/HC notes record labour at 22.55, SPH at 24.13 and sales at £28,982.12.
Food variance was 4.9%, around 0.4 over because of sugar, which has been handled with Sophie and O.

Ziang Lin attributed the £4,000 shortfall against target to weak delivery sales and said South England needs a delivery push, aiming to grow weekly delivery revenue from about £1.6K towards £4K to £5K with continuous promotions such as 30% off on Thursdays and Sundays.
Lakeside has moved up the delivery league, level with Manchester on 39 points, and has had zero delivery rejections or cancellations for three consecutive weeks.
The site reports it is fully prepared for the upcoming large Slurp promotion, with delivery stations equipped.

One 1 star Google review was removed; for a 2 star review about overly crispy chicken, photos were checked with Remy and Sophie, who found the food fine, and the guest was invited back but has not returned or replied.

The BOH meeting covered a 1 star and a 3 star review citing burnt chicken in the yakisoba and cold chicken karaage; Sophie said the yakisoba portions looked too small and went through proper reheating of karaage to avoid dryness and cold centres.
Staffing has reduced: Tom has handed in his notice, two other FOH team members no longer work at the site, and a BOH backup is being sought, with recruitment also under way through Ashish from O2.
Ziang Lin questioned the lack of a clear management structure; Jocelyn and Dave hold the senior roles, but Dave is still training as a supervisor.
An assistant manager capable of progressing to GM must be hired by the end of the month.
Kei Cannon will work on site on Saturday and Sunday this week and on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday next week to stabilise the site.
Four FOH team members are now kitchen trained, and FOH and BOH are being asked to work together because the kitchen is short of staff.
The BOH audit (Srawut) found wet floors from canopy cleaning, messy kitchen organisation, double labelling and incorrect expiry dates on tofu and broccoli, and staff must follow the wakame recipe.

The GM/HC notes say kitchen cleanliness and date labelling have now been kept up for three weeks and an audit has been passed, though this week's BOH audit still found labelling and expiry date failures.
A maintenance issue with the ramen fridge seal is to be logged; no other maintenance issues were reported in the meeting.
Steak ran out on Monday and vegan chicken deliveries were delayed, but stock was otherwise fine.
The compliance tracker shows a service due in two weeks.
Halloween After Dark is set, and Becca has approved free guest singer performances from the Lakeside talent pool.
A three day work fair is planned to collect CVs for Christmas staff and drive sales.
Areas for improvement are customer focus and revenue (staff outside talking to people to increase sales) and keeping the doors open correctly and the lights on.
The management tracker has been updated.
Local B2B outreach for the 15% staff discount programme continued around Lakeside, including hotels and workplaces.
